title: fping-watch
tagline: A ping monitor with a 24-hour web view, built on zig-fping.
summary: A small daemon that pings a list of hosts once a minute and shows, per host, its status, latency and packet loss over the last 24 hours. This public instance is read-only: you see what it measures, nobody can change what it pings.
features: One row per host: status, a strip of recent cycles, 24-hour uptime and current latency
Click a row for its 24-hour latency chart with packet loss underneath
Paced probing: 5 echo requests per host per minute, spread out, never a burst
Built for many viewers: the page reads cached results and never triggers a ping
built_with: Zig 0.17 and zig-fping, a Zig port of fping; one static binary, no libc, no dependencies
screenshot_alt: fping-watch: a list of hosts with status, recent cycles and uptime; one row expanded to its 24-hour latency chart
